Posted March 7, 2003
Analysis by Richard Cowan

Most people, including Canadians, are so conditioned NOT to take cannabis seriously puns in headlines, references to Cheech and Chong, etc., that it will be inconceivable to most of them that their national identity could be determined by how they deal with the issue of medical cannabis refugees.
See
Ottawa Citizen Practices First Class Journalism
A Brilliantly Insightful Editorial: " Marijuana isn't just a serious issue. It's huge. "

But they should stop and look at the choices that are being laid out before them now that these refugee hearings have begun.
See
Kubby Refugee Hearings Begin. Canadian Government Does Not Assert That There Can Be No Refugees From DEAland. Special to MarijuanaNews.

There are two choices. The old Canada rejects medical cannabis. The Health Minister says that thinking about it causes her discomfort and medical users are still subject to arrest in much of the country.
See
Canadian Health Minister Seeks Asylum In DEAland; Says Making Her Think About Medical Cannabis Constitutes Torture. In DC They Don't Allow That Sort of Thing. Thinking, That Is.

The government has scrapped a medical access program that was supposed to supply patients with government grown cannabis. (It will be used only in research.) It has also appealed a court ruling that would have required that it come up with a workable program within six months.

On the other hand, the new Canada has issued exemptions to hundreds of patients and allows them to grow and/or possess cannabis for medical use and largely tolerates the operation of buyers clubs in most of the larger cities

The old Canada tried to argue before the Supreme Court that the current laws against possession were just, while the new Canada, represented by the same officials from the Justice Ministry, was proposing a bill to decriminalize possession, because the penalties were unjust. The Supreme Court was not amused.
See
Canadian Supreme Court Punts On Cannabis Cases Until Spring. The Games Governments Play Prove The Need for International Debate on Cannabis Prohibition. Special to MarijuanaNews

The old Canada is very concerned about its trade with its huge Southern neighbor and does not want to aggravate the fanatical prohibitionists who talk like they can close the border. (They can't. The trade is too important on both sides.)
See
As Canada Moves Toward Some Form Of Decriminalization, Canadian Narks and Walters Escalate Lying. The New Math. Canada Replaces Mexico As Leading Supplier of Cannabis. And If You Believe That

The new Canada takes pride in its human rights record, and likes to think of itself as being more humane and egalitarian than DEAland. Certainly, its criminal justice system is radically different in its approach to punishment. It has no death penalty, and sentences for almost all crimes are much shorter than those in the incarceration champion, previously known as the Land of the Free.
See
Cannabis Friendly Cities Rank Highest In International Quality of Life Survey. For personal safety, Lowest scoring city in North America is Washington D.C Lessons for Civic Leaders. Special Report.

The old Canada will not confront the lying by their police who follow the DEAland party line.
See
Canadians Need to Examine The Role of the Police In Maintaining Marijuana Prohibition. Paying For Lies That Distort Public Policies and Undermine Sovereignty. Analysis by Richard Cowan

But the new Canada wants to keep its cultural independence and is often instinctively anti-American, although usually in a nice Canadian sort of way. (Most Canadians are very opposed to the Iraq war, and the American-style drug war.)

Such internal conflicts are hardly unique to Canada, but most countries are left to sort out their internal conflicts on their own time. Canadians do not have that luxury. They recognize that there are many advantages to having its steroidal neighbor, but they also know that the noise from next door often keeps them awake.

Now is just such a time, and the noise is coming from American medical cannabis refugees who have fled north in the tradition of the 19th century's Underground Railroad for slaves, and the 20th century's haven for Vietnam draft-dodgers. In fact, this latest movement has elements of both.

Today was the third day of the hearing for Steve Kubby, and it got off to a somewhat bumpy start that illustrated both of the two Canadas.

Yesterday, while Steve was ill and his wife, Michele, was on her own, the representative of the Immigration minister tried a little hard ball. So, this morning, Steve demanded that the whole bunch recuse themselves, and start over! Of course, they ruled against that, but they quickly went back to being Canadian nice.

As I reported on Wednesday, the Immigration Ministry has not made the rejection of refugees from DEAland an absolute position of the Canadian government, and today the Adjudicator said that the refugee claimants only have to meet the standards of the preponderance of the evidence not beyond a reasonable doubt. That is very important, although the evidence seems overwhelming.
See
Kubby Refugee Hearings Begin. Canadian Government Does Not Assert That There Can Be No Refugees From DEAland. Special to MarijuanaNews.

In fact, it quickly became evident that the Canadians simply have no idea what is really going on in the great democracy to the south. (No, not Mexico.) When Steve began to tell the story about the grotesque behavior of the police in his case, they were clearly shocked.
See
After Lockyer Says He Won't Fight To Support Rights Under Prop 215
Former California Libertarian Party Gubernatorial Candidate And Medical Marijuana Patient
Steve Kubby Arrested On Cultivation And " Conspiracy " Charges!
and
Orange County Register Denounces Kubby Arrest As " Outrage in Law "
and
Judge Releases Kubbys On Own Recognizance.
Libertarian Party Organizations Now Committed To The Marijuana Issue.
Large Number Of Plants Will Force Dealing With Difficult Questions
-- Analysis By Richard Cowan
and
Evidence In Kubby Case Obtained Through Bedroom Surveillance;
Narcs Observed And Videotaped Kubbys Having Sex

When the Canadian government is confronted with the facts about how deeply corrupted by cannabis prohibition the DEAland criminal justice and political systems have become, that should help them clarify their own thinking about what kind of nation that they want to be.

It is often difficult to recognize one's own flaws, but easy to seem them reflected in others.

The Canadians are about to discover another unexpected advantage to having a neighbor that is even more conflicted than they are. They can look south and then look in the mirror and ask themselves if they want to succumb to the lies and hatred that have conquered its great neighbor from within.

America has become DEAland. I don't think that this is something Canadians want to emulate, but that is the choice that they are going to have to make. I m betting on the new Canada. The refugees are betting their lives.
